verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch has a managed cloud offering, so a policy or control against using customer data for AI training is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has no statement, setting, or policy about AI training opt-out or data-usage restrictions. Self-managed and on-prem deployment options are an adjacent workaround, not a documented no-training control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
